about: Hand-worked geo cases (docs/geo-contract.md). Expected values are closed-form arithmetic shown in `work` (distances on a meridian are R x pi/180 x |dLat|), not output of any implementation. `data` names a dataset (null = the call takes no D); `patch` replaces whole top-level keys of that dataset (null deletes nothing: it sets the key to null). The strings __NaN__, __Infinity__ and __-Infinity__ in args stand for those numbers. Unrounded numbers compare with a relative tolerance of 1e-9 (or 1e-9 absolute near 0).

cases.work: Z1 is 10 usable ZIPs on longitude 0 (lat x1000: 10000 twice, 10010, 10030 twice, 9940, 10100, 9850, 10210, 10280) plus 15 malformed records that must be skipped (bad city index, 4-digit zip, decimal lat, lowercase state, 3 fields, empty, 6 fields, non-digit lat, state with a trailing newline, Arabic-Indic digits in the zip, a city entry that is a number, a 400-digit lat, lat 95.000, lon -181.000, an Arabic-Indic digit in lat). Most sit between 10.001 and 10.009, so counting one would change the spacings below. Along a meridian, distance = R*pi/180*|dLat| = 69.094094427952 mi per degree. 10 usable.
